notes.title: Working towards 0.13
notes.content:
Hello! You might have noticed it's been a while since the last update, but here's the reason why - 0.13 is a massive change and as I work on SH2 single-handed in my spare time, it's a little slow on progress.

However, so you're not completely in the dark here's what's coming.

0.13 will be the final early access update and features many new gameplay elements in SH2 as well as cosmetic changes. This is not a complete list of everything that's changing but should give you the idea.

First off behind the scenes, most of the random elements are being replaced. The Investigators for example will largely no longer visit houses at random but now analyse patterns (the Detective is the best at this of course) of your murders and attempt to ascertain where you might strike next - so if up to now you've systematically murdered a whole street as a strategy, that's not going to work any longer as they will spot what you're up to and may order the Lookout to guard that street. However, you can of course use that against them - by appearing to be following a set routine and then giving them the old switcharoo!

All roles now have many more events attached to them as well as changes of behaviour dependent on what's been going on. RNG is as far as possible being replaced with behaviour that reacts to your actions.

New shader and particle effects have been added to make things look nicer. As a caveat the following images are very much work in progress - there are placeholders in the following images and things may change drastically before release.

Onto cakes - there are now twice as many of these and their effects are buffed up if you put the flesh of a best friend into them.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/t3MzX0z/cakes.png[/img]

The roster is completely overhauled. You can scroll around, zoom in and out and pin post-it notes onto it for little reminders. You can also sort the roster in various ways, such as A to Z, known roles, addresses, species, gender, friendship and status (as pictured).

[img]https://i.ibb.co/LRNz6F4/sh2-20-26-27-1-2024.png[/img]

Baking cakes now takes place in a little 3D physics world kitchen.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/X8Mwhy4/sh2-19-20-27-1-2024.png[/img]

When you send Snapper to the crematorium you now can get him to choose which flesh to steal rather than he brings back something at random. Here he is in the crematorium in glorious first-person gatorvision.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/TRN50Yh/gator.png[/img]

Something that's been requested almost since the game first appeared, you can now make your own custom ponies to populate your town with. You can also share individual ponies or entire towns with QR code images.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Gp500n4/1.png[/img]

You can have up to 16 different sets of ponies. with up to the game maximum of 40 ponies per set.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/SwM3rd8/2.png[/img]

You'll then see your ponies wandering around town as little 3D paper sprites. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/jbVg7Mb/sh2-19-26-27-1-2024.png[/img]

And there might be a few other new surprises too.

I'm working when I can to bring this out, but at the moment it's very much 'when it's ready'. Happy horse hunting!

notes.title: Early Access 0.12.2 update
notes.content:
Hello folks,

[i]This is a smallish update earlier than was intended, primarily to address the video issues some players were experiencing.[/i]

Bugfix: Snapper's green marker now appears next to house numbers again to show he has been there before.

Bugfix: Gamepad now works correctly on the setup screen.

Bugfix: Love icons were not being properly revealed on the roster screen.

Feature: Option to disable videos added on the initial warning screen. If the codec fix still doesn't work for you, you can use this option for now.

Feature: Four "Challenge Modes" added. These will make the game harder, but you'll get special achievements if you win with them! More will be added in future updates.

Feature: If your game is running faster than intended, you will be notified on the title screen (I've seen a few streamers playing at 120fps!)

Feature: Friendship is now factored into invitations in the cake shop. A pony must be at least an 'acquaintance' to accept an invitation. If you offer an invitation to a pony who doesn't rate as a friend you will lose that cake shop turn but you will retain your rejected invitation.

Cheers and all

Catfood

notes.title: Version 0.12 hotfix
notes.content:
Caught a couple of bugs post update, including a real stinker.

* If your game is running too fast and you switch to FORCE SYNC on options, it *should* now take effect immediately instead of on a restart.

Much gratitude to Twitch streamer Partycannons whose stream helped me track these down!

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.12
notes.content:
Hello Horse Hackers,

Here is update Early Access 0.12. Which includes:

Bugfix: Alicorns roster images didn't turn into Alicorns after transformation. This also affected the Spy's glitch.

Bugfix: Raycasting fixed on the town screen, so now the closest house is selected on a click rather than the raycast deciding you want a house in the distance.

Bugfix: Pony Horse has been evicted from your house.

Gameplay: At the start of the game the Spy now has three files on hand rather than two, so if you manage to kill the Changeling on night one, you still have to make a choice. The Changeling will still add a file every so often, until she has gathered a maximum of twelve.

Gameplay: There are now additional special events linked to specific townie roles, as well as hidden special characters.

Gameplay: If you send your pet out to plant evidence, you can now choose how much of your stock to send him with. This allows you to keep some back for cakes. The more evidence he plants at a house, the longer it will last.

Gameplay: Previously your sanity was restored by 10% if you murdered a council member but there was no bonus for townsponies. You will now get a small sanity bonus for murdering them too.

Gameplay: The Disciple was a bit too laid-back and seldom got mad with you. This is no longer the case. Once you have killed half the town, the risk of them turning on you kicks in.

Feature: There is a new building on the town screen, a crematorium. On the days when a pony has been cremated, this will be pouring out pony barbeque smoke in the morning.

Feature: If a pony has been killed, the survivors will immediately put up a little memorial stone by the church. What kind of stone depends on their role.

Feature: Once the Changeling Spy is dead, their roster image changes to that of a Changeling.

Feature: The game is now compatible with most gamepads. Please note that the gamepad must be connected before you start the game, pads connected after the game is running will not be detected.

Feature: You can now save and load up to nine Death Letters using the icons on the Death Letter screen, so if you type a real zinger you can use it again in another game. Bear in mind a letter that was super effective on one horse might not work as well on another, and repetition (in the same game) reduces letter efficacy. 

Feature: The back of the tarot cards have had a facelift and now feature the Night Mare.

Feature: You can now set the quality of shadows in the options menu. Shadows considerably affect performance, so if you find the 3D scenes laggy try turning these down or off.

Feature: Your house is now a unique model in the town.

Feature: Two new knives have been added, which you can obtain via specific achievements. If you already have the achievement, the knife will be unlocked.

Feature: The gallows. As the town's rage increases, you will notice they start putting up a gallows in the town square. Once this is complete, the town might start with some lynchings!

Feature: The background music is now complete, featuring 20 original tracks. It's possible There might be extra music available as a DLC in the future.

Feature: A music player. Access this from the 'customise' option on the main menu. You can use this to play the tracks outside of the game and remove any from the playlist that you don't dig on.

Feature: The town now has little ponies wandering around. These are just grey placeholders at the moment. How many of them relates to the current population. They are not very bright right now and clip through things, but at least it makes the place look a bit more lived in.

Achievements: The achievement for Pony Horse turning up on the roster has been renamed from "The Horse, The Legend" to "The Losty Legend" in honor of the YouTuber who made Pony Horse a thing.

Known bugs: The Wiki is outdated and doesn't work very well, nor is it gamepad linked. This will be replaced in a future update.

Known bugs: Bug reporting via the options screen is currently offline. You can report a bug by emailing directly to mail@catsmeat.com

TTFN!

- Catfood

notes.title: Slaughter Horse 2 OST update
notes.content:
Greetings. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450910/Slaughter_Horse_2_OST/]The Slaughter Horse 2 original soundtrack[/url] has been updated, and at 21 original in-game tracks that span for over an hour, it is now considered complete.

All the main tracks have been remastered so you should be able to hear them with a little more clarity than previously. 

Track 9, "Ticking off the Hitlist" I was never very happy with as it had a few audio issues too annoying to correct and besides it didn't feel like it belonged with the rest of the tracks. It has been replaced with new track "Murder Funk". However, you can still find it on the bonus tracks.

There are ten new tracks added to the OST:
[list]
[*] Murder Funk
[*] Genocide in A#
[*] Then You Disappear Forever
[*] (Horse Noises)
[*] Nobody Here But Us Ghosts
[*] The Night Mare Rides Again
[*] Windchill
[*] Ponymonium
[*] Tastes Like Yellow
[*] Requiem for the Mares
[/list]
These won't appear in the actual game until the next update which is probably a couple of weeks off, so if you bought/buy the OST consider your early access to the new music a thank-you bonus.

Musically yours,

Catfood

notes.title: Early Access 0.11
notes.content:
Hello colt-carvers. Here's the additions to the new update, early access 0.11

[list]
[*] Bugfix: Pony flesh is no longer carried over to a new game.

[*] Gameplay: Death Letters! You can now get your pet to deliver a nasty letter to another pony. They can have many different results, depending on who you send them to and the contents. This can help or hinder you, so use them wisely.

[*] Gameplay: On the final roster screen, you will now see who the Disciple was if they are still alive by the end.

[*] Gameplay: Another knife has been added to the trophy knives. There are now four to collect.

[*] Gameplay: Knives are linked to Steam achievements as well as saved in the game files, so if you have already fulfilled the requirements for a knife it will be available.

[*] Gameplay: There is a new unique death for a specific pony.

[*] Gameplay: The game will now remember if you were last on the town view in overhead or street view and which street you were looking at, rather than resetting to overhead view each time. It will reset to overhead view if you left the town screen on free view. Freeview mode is now on a separate button at the top right of the town screen.

[*] Gameplay: The game will display tips on each screen for when you're new to the game. You can switch these off on the options screen.

[*] Gameplay: To make the Veteran slightly less harsh, they can now no longer kill you outright the first time you attack their house while they are on alert but they will be able to on any subsequent visits. There are still serious consequences to your suspicion, and this rule does not apply if you have put them on extra high alert with a Death Letter!

[*] Gameplay: If you manage to put the Veteran on extra high alert, they will now kill most ponies who show up on their doorstop like the Vet in SH1. This effect lasts one night only, and you cannot force the Vet to do this twice, as if you don't show up and kill them after the first letter they will they dismiss anything you send them as empty threats from a pinko pantywaist. The Magician is immune to this even if they check the Vet as they do not ever actually leave their house, as is the Alicorn who is too distinctive to mistake for anyone else.

[*] Feature: If you order Snapper to deliver a Death Letter or a cake, he will now be carrying this item when he scurries away.

[*] Feature: When awarded a cutie mark, you can now examine it by holding down the left mouse button and moving the mouse, rather than it following the mouse regardless.

[*] Feature: As alligators are not reknown for writing, Snapper will now talk to you in Alligator, which fortunately you understand. You can also praise or scold him on his reports.

[*] Feature: There is now a bit of speech, generated by the app "Deep Ponies". There is only a female voice at the moment.

[*] Steam Achievements: 12 new achievements added.
[/list]

TTFN!

- Catfood

notes.title: Early Access 0.10 - The Long Knives Update
notes.content:
Happy Friday, Mare Maimers. Here's what we have this week. Thanks to Discord User Issac Pony for the artwork!

[list]
[*] Gameplay: Each council role now has unique murder description text.

[*] Bugfix: Your pet's house check indicator is now working again.

[*] Feature: New secret achievement added.

[*] Feature: On the game's final roster screen, you will now be able to see who the Mule was, as well as the Spy if you never found out.

[*] Feature: The game will remember your preferences for population and thaw time. You can change these in the custom options and also on starting a new game.
[/list]

TTFN!

notes.title: Early Access 0.9
notes.content:
Hello colt cullers. I've been out of the loop for a bit, but here with are with another Early Access update.

This time around we have...

[list]
[*] Gameplay: If your suspicion is greater than 95% the Mayor will not step in to prevent a lynching, as your guilt is now beyond all reasonable doubt.

[*] Gameplay: The town has been completely reworked - this is the majority content of this update. Ponies no longer live in four straight lines! There are several ways to view, via the buttons on the town screen. The town is still under construction but is functional. During freeview, use W/A/S/D and Q/E to move, hold SHIFT to speed up and RIGHT MOUSE to switch between move and select (Don't worry, the game will remind you of this).

[*] Feature: The old town view on the new day screen is now a view of the new town, replacing the old pixel art.

[*] Music: Two new tracks, "Snowfall" and "Nightmares".

[*] Bugfix: The town would sometimes get the gender wrong when a pony was hanged.

[*] Bugfix: The Vet's bullet holes should now be on the correct layer.
 
[*] Bugfix: The fruit cake and sachertorte were not affecting ponies correctly.

[*] Achievements: No less than 9 new achievements to collect, ranging from easy to extremely hard.
[/list]

As ever, I'd recommend starting a new game as trying to load a save from a previous build will probably cause a horrible crash.

TTFN!

- Catfo0d

notes.title: Slaughter Horse 2 - Early Access 0.7
notes.content:
Hello Horse hackers. This update has been mostly about upgrading some graphical elements. Things should now be a bit prettier, but there's still a way to go!

The Shaders are all on by default, but if your machine struggles with them the option to cull them down will appear in a future build. However, as AppGameKit Studio is mostly concerned with mobile apps they shouldn't be too demanding for a reasonable machine. My PC is one of those ones you get ready made from eBay for about £300 and it blasts it all no trouble, but as ever, let me know if you find issues!

The way files are saved has been slightly changed, so if you continue with a previous game there might be unpredictable effects. If so, time to start a new game!

Otherwise:

Bugfix: After being exposed by the Blackmailer or Rememberer your sus would reset. Should be fixed.

Bugfix: An array error on Gummy's screen related to your sanity. Fixed.

Bugfix: Exploit fixed where if you went onto options on the tarot screen and came back out, you could see the names of the hidden cards. You didn't know that? Too late now!

Bugfix: Ponies quit work if their sanity damage hit 10%, so if you were finding the game was suddenly way easier there's your reason why. Fixed.

notes.title: Early Access 0.5 - The Friendship Update
notes.content:
SLAUGHTER HORSE 2 - Early access update 0.5
[u]
THE FRIENDSHIP UPDATE[/u]

**NOTE: There have been a lot of changes since the previous update. If you attempt to continue a game you saved in 0.4, it's most likely going to crash horribly or at least behave weirdly!

Bugfix: The Spy's remarks on the town would be erased if you saved and then reloaded a game.

Bugfix: There was an error in the town's AI which meant the council and investigators tended to work way less than they should. Now fixed.

Bugfix: Sometimes some bits of text failed to appear. I *think* this is now corrected.

Options: A player reported that the glitch/static effects caused them some discomfort. You can now switch them off in options.

Feature: Snapper now scurries away once you have given him orders.

Feature: Regular murder texts expanded.

Feature: Random events expanded.

Feature: Reporter's bulletin board improved.

Feature: There is a little animated event when the Preacher finds the Spy. This is pretty much a placeholder but it's a start.

Feature: Suspicion levels have been reworked. All ponies now have their own personal level of suspicion for everyone else. Your suspicion level is the average of how every remaining pony feels about you. This means you can improve your general rating by eliminating those most suspicious of you.

Feature: Friendship! Ponies have varying levels of friendliness towards others which will influence their actions and voting during lynches. The death of good friends will impact their sanity and/or demeanour. They will also share their suspicions about others.

Feature: Lynching is no longer entirely handled in the background. If there is a successful lynch mob, the two ponies the town considers the most suspicious will be put on trial and a vote will be taken. Ponies personal suspicion and relationships with the two accused ponies will affect how they vote. You may also vote - as long as you're not accused yourself.

Feature: There is a new left-screen info icon for your friendship rating. This indicates the overall feeling towards you in the town.

Feature: There is a new icon in the shop, 'Friendship'. Use this to try and make friends with a customer. Success will rely on their general demeanour and how much you already know about them. You may also improve friendship with the other questioning options, but aiming entirely for friendship has a better chance of success.

Feature: There are new icons for the roster cards that indicate how friendly a pony feels towards you, as well as their current suspicion of you and their sanity. You can reveal these icons by sending your pet to investigate a pony or by being friendly in the cake shop. Other ponies may also reveal these icons about others. Once they are revealed, you will be able to keep an eye on these stats for the rest of the game - or that particular pony's lifetime.

Feature: Ingredients that you possess are now highlighted on the recipe card, making it easier to see right away if you can bake a particular cake.

Feature: Music now starts at a random track when you first start rather than at track one every time.

Music: One track removed as I didn't think it worked too well. But on the plus side, there are two new ones! nb: I've been asked a few times now if I would make the soundtrack available as DLC. There are currently 10 tracks and my aim is for the game to feature about 20. When I feel it's completed, I will make it available as DLC and on music streaming platforms.

Misc: Roads on the town map now accept shadows.

Misc: Christmas season is over!

Godspeed, ponies.

- Catfood

notes.title: Early Access 0.4 - The Festive Weekend Update
notes.content:
Hello Merry Mare Maulers,

Here is Early Access 0.4. The major change is Snapper's facelift, but there's one or two bugfixes included as well as some seasonal fare - including a Steam achievement you can only win during this festive and heartwarming time.

The next update will concentrate primarily on killing all the bugs I've had reported so far (and found myself).

Time to block up your chimney.

- Catfood

notes.title: Early Access 0.3 - The Weekend Update
notes.content:
Greetings stallion-shankers, Early Access 0.3 has been uploaded to Steam.

>Bugfix: Saving and exiting a game then starting a new one would cause a graphical mess by the 3D elements.

>Bugfix: If you accessed the Options with the roster open, the roster text would still be visible.

>Bugfix: The Disciple *should* no longer report the Veteran is visiting someone and should instead report if the Vet is on alert or not.

>Feature: Murder text expanded.

>Feature: You can now exit the cake bake and return to the night phase, as long as you haven’t already started a bake.

>Feature: If you attempt to add a third ‘herb’ to the bake, it will be rejected.

>Feature: Cake recipe generation has been reworked so that there are no longer any useless herbs.

>Feature: You can now click the recipe book after a successful bake if you need a reminder of what you just made

>Feature: The recipe book can now be accessed via the right-side buttons. Cakes already made will show as crossed out, as you can only make each cake once per game.

>Feature: On the player agreeing that the game contains horrid things, the warning will not appear again.

>Feature: 2 new secret achievements added.

>Music: Additional in-game track “The Listener” added (Grandaddy influenced, this one)

>Music: Additional in-game track “Music to Lynch by” added.

If you resume a game saved in 0.2, it should still work but there may be unpredictable results.

The bugs are finally getting fewer, so hopefully future updates will now mostly concern themselves with dealing and improving specific parts of the game. Thank you for all your support so far during release week!

- Catfood

notes.title: Early Access 0.2
notes.content:
Greetings. Early Access 0.2 has been uploaded to Steam.

>Bugfix: Issue where you would still find the lookout on patrol even if they had died during the day phase.

>Bugfix: Issue where clicking the wiki or options button during a wipe caused a graphical upset.

>Feature: Tips and “LOADING” added to the loading screen to make it clearer that’s what’s happening.

>Feature: Snowfall on the town screen will decrease as the thaw draws nearer.

>Feature: Warning displayed on loading.

>Gameplay: There is now unique murder text for the Alicorn.

>Gameplay: How many red buttons are hidden on the interview screens now relates to your sanity instead of your luck.

>Gameplay: Once the Alicorn appears, the Royal Guard will now station themselves at the Alicorn’s house *every* night that the Alicorn is at home. If the Alicorn is working, the Guard may position themselves somewhere else in the town or take a night off. You must therefore kill the Guard before you can dispose of the Alicorn directly.

- Catfood

notes.title: Slaughter Horse 2 : Early Access is live
notes.content:
Welcome horse-stabbers, to the very first early access release of Slaughter Horse 2!

The game is fully playable, and many thanks to you if you've bought it - there is a great deal of content I want to add to the game over the next few updates as well as much polish and lots more pony-pranging fun.

So watch out for updates as we squash bugs, add events, tidy up the rougher edges and thanks for joining the party. Player feedback is invaluable, so if you have anything to suggest or point out please feel free to join the Discord server, post on the Steam forums or mail me directly.

What was intended to be a two-month palate cleanser project turned into six months (so far) of horse-level slog. I hope you have fun.

Now show those ponies what friendship is REALLY all about.

- CF
